description: Mark the binary members of the three multipart-only operations as file parts. Discord spells binary bodies as `{ type: string, contentEncoding: binary }` (OAS 3.1); the OpenAPI→Smithy converter has no binary vocabulary, so those members land as plain `smithy.api#String` and the generated input would reject the File/Blob the multipart protocol actually wants. Each member is retargeted to `smithy.api#Document` (→ `S.Unknown`, since the payload is opaque bytes rather than a string) and stamped with `com.distilled.discord#formDataFile`, which binds it to `T.FormDataFile()` with a `File | Blob` TS type (see the extraBindings entry in scripts/generate.ts); the core REST protocol appends those members as form parts. Only these three operations are affected: every other multipart endpoint also offers application/json, and the converter's content-type precedence (json > form-urlencoded > multipart) picks JSON for those — file attachments on message endpoints are therefore not reachable through the generated surface.
